notes: The Big Fat Cat Update: Cat Council: ask your sidekicks anything — click your sidekick, “Ask” on a Cat Chat card, or Help → Ask the cats. Biscuit knows your money and what happened while you were away, Le Chonk your risk and why trading stopped, Le Chill your strategies and experiments, Katya your losses and anything unusual (still a secret). Every answer uses your real balances, bets, settings, logs and experiment results, labels each number (real money, practice, simulated, historical test, estimate, live market) with the time it was read, shows the evidence and how sure it is, and says when it doesn’t know. The cats can open the right screen, preview a Clump change, start a fake-money experiment, fetch current prices and offer to resume — real-money changes still need the usual confirmations. They work offline, for free.
